issue.title: closed `AsdfFile` instances hold private reference to tree

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the issue, but the fix introduced a regression: asdf/_tests/test_info.py::test_info_module passed before the fix and fails after it, and no test was found that guards the original bug. Look first at why test_info_module now fails (likely something still reading the tree after the file is closed), and consider adding a test that checks tree objects can be garbage collected…
